description: This file defines the `LogView` class, which is a custom Android `TextView` used for displaying log data received through the `LogNode` interface. It formats and appends log messages with various priority levels and supports chaining with other `LogNode` instances.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom `TextView` that implements `LogNode` to display log messages within an Android UI, with methods to format and display logs, and chain log nodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and outputs a log message, converting priority to readable text, optionally including an exception stack trace, and updating the UI thread.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next `LogNode` in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next `LogNode` in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append strings conditionally with delimiters.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Outputs a string as a new line in the log display.
